# MeoArch

> MeoArch is an Arch Linux based desktop system (Meo = Modern, Expressive, Open). Its apps share the MeoUI Qt Quick / QML design system.
> This file is for coding agents that build on MeoUI. Repository-specific rules live in each repository's AGENTS.md; read it first, it takes precedence.

## About

- [About MeoArch](https://meoarch.org/docs/guide/about.md): What MeoArch is and why it is called that.
- [Requirements](https://meoarch.org/docs/guide/requirements.md): What you need to try MeoArch, Meo AI and the Meo apps.
- [Legal](https://meoarch.org/docs/guide/legal.md): All policies and open-source licenses of MeoArch's sites and apps in one place.
- [Terms of Service](https://meoarch.org/docs/guide/terms.md): The terms for using Meo Account and Meo AI: accounts, your content, AI output, tools, acceptable use, liability.
- [Privacy Policy](https://meoarch.org/docs/guide/privacy.md): What Meo Account and Meo AI store, who receives data, how long, and how to export or delete it.
- [Meo Account API](https://meoarch.org/docs/guide/account-api.md): How to sign in, read account data, manage sessions and backups, call Meo AI, and read the streaming format, errors, models and plan limits.
- [Native App Integration](https://meoarch.org/docs/guide/account-native-apps.md): How a desktop app uses Meo Account: client manifest, getting its own token, asking the broker to call the API, usage upload.

## MeoUI specification

Start with "Rules for Coding Agents", then read only the document that matches the task.

- [MeoUI Specification](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/index.md): Index and core rules: ownership, tokens, components, localization, evidence, files.
- [App Shell](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/app-shell.md): Window chrome and toolbar, where app settings live and how they are grouped, About, open-source credits.
- [Settings Pattern](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/settings.md): Settings rows, groups, sidebar, task sheet, state layer and motion.
- [Page Types](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/page-types.md): Page kinds, the two-level rule and registry metadata.
- [Foundations](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/foundations.md): Page style, surfaces, color, type, shape, spacing, elevation, icons, motion, accessibility.
- [Layout](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/layout.md): Window size classes, page skeletons, columns, scrolling and compact behavior.
- [Navigation](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/navigation.md): Bottom bar, rail, sidebar, tabs, back, search and the top app bar.
- [Cards](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/cards.md): Card versus row versus group, types, anatomy, sizes, states and grids.
- [Lists](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/lists.md): List rows, connected groups, headers, tables and long lists.
- [Buttons and Forms](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/forms.md): Button hierarchy, text fields, selection controls and form layout.
- [Dialogs and Alerts](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/dialogs.md): Choosing a surface, dialogs, destructive confirmation, sheets, snackbars and banners.
- [Progress and Loading](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/progress.md): Progress indicators, skeletons, long-running tasks and timing.
- [Empty and Error States](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/states.md): Empty, error, offline, stale and no-access states.
- [Detail Pages](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/detail-pages.md): Entity and app detail page anatomy, adaptive layout and states.
- [Writing](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/writing.md): Voice, buttons, messages, tooltips and localization-safe wording.
- [Worked Examples](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/examples.md): Worked compositions and a page review procedure.
- [Store Feedback](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/store-feedback.md): Store pages, install button states, progress indicators, error and empty states.
- [Dynamic Color](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/dynamic-color.md): The mandatory dynamic color role table and who generates it.
- [API Lifecycle](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/api-lifecycle.md): Current, deprecated, experimental and internal components.
- [Localization](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/localization.md): Language precedence, translation catalogs and accessible names.
- [Rules for Coding Agents](https://meoarch.org/docs/meoui/for-agents.md): The same rules as decision tables and checklists for AI coding agents.
